page_title: ATM 1-0 OSA | Atletico Madrid v Osasuna 18/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Ricardo De Burgos shows a yellow card to Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) for his blatant foul.
89' Osasuna force a corner. They send men into the box.

89' A pass into the box finds Ante Budimir (Osasuna) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom left corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Jan Oblak denies him. The ball goes out for a corner. Osasuna can continue in their attacking effort.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Iker Munoz (Osasuna) is coming onto the pitch as Jon Moncayola cannot continue after picking up an injury.
85' Alessio Lisci has decided to substitute Victor Munoz and he is replaced by Sheraldo Becker (Osasuna).
85' Giacomo Raspadori (Atl. Madrid) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
82' Substitution. Giacomo Raspadori (Atl. Madrid) has come on for Julian Alvarez.
81' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
78' Iker Benito (Osasuna) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
78' Kike Barja (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
78' The attendance for today's match is 62884.
76' Giuliano Simeone plays a short lofted pass to Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid), whose header from the centre of the box drifts well past the left post.
74' Here is a change. Lucas Torro is going off and Alessio Lisci gives the last tactical orders to Kike Barja (Osasuna).
74' The game has come to an end for Jorge Herrando. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
74' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) touches the ball with his hand.
72' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
69' 1 - 0 Goal! Giuliano Simeone feeds Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 1:0.
67' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
66' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
66' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) latches onto a cross into the box from the wing and gets in a header. It went well towards the goal, but it was blocked by one of the defenders.
66' 16:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. 8:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
64' Iker Benito (Osasuna) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
63' Diego Simeone has decided to make a change. Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) replaces Alex Baena.
63' Ruben Garcia goes off the pitch and Moi Gomez (Osasuna) comes on.
61' Julian Alvarez swings the cross over. Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) gets his head to it but it goes just over the crossbar.

59' Unbelievable miss! Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) gets himself into a great position from the corner, but sends his header well wide of the right post from in front of goal when it was easier to score.
59' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) will take a corner kick.

58' Sergio Herrera pulls off a great save to deny Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner. The linesman points to the corner flag, Atl. Madrid are going to take it.
58' Giuliano Simeone received a sweet pass from Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid), but the advance is stopped.

57' Iker Benito (Osasuna) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
55' Here's the change. Antoine Griezmann leaves the pitch and Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) comes on as a substitute.
54' Today's match ends for Koke who will be replaced by Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid).

53' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Sergio Herrera thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
52' The resulting corner from Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

51' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Sergio Herrera was alert and the score remained the same.
50' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is repeatedly being caught offside, but this is to be expected given that he always plays on the shoulder of the last defender.
49' Some patient build-up play from Atl. Madrid as they look to unlock the defence.
48' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Marcos Llorente. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
46' The whistle blows and Ricardo De Burgos starts the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the right post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.

45+2' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Chance! Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but Sergio Herrera is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
44' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
43' Problems for Diego Simeone as Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Giuliano Simeone replaces him.
42' It doesn’t look good for Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
41' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) is substituted due to injury. Alessio Lisci gives a chance to Iker Benito.
40' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
38' A shot from the edge of the box by David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) is a waste and goes well wide of the right post.
38' Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle for a foul after Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) hacks down one of his opponents.
37' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on. Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) is able to continue to play.

35' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment. The game is interrupted now, Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
34' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
33' Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle as Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
31' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
31' The total number of attempts is 7:3. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 2:1.
31' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) as he fails to deliver a decent cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
30' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Koke (Atl. Madrid) was quite harsh and Ricardo De Burgos didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

27' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a projectile from close range to the bottom right corner, but Jan Oblak makes a nice save.
26' Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle after Koke (Atl. Madrid) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Osasuna are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
25' Koke (Atl. Madrid) sends a long cross over to Nicolas Gonzalez, but Sergio Herrera comes forward to gather the ball.
24' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post.

23' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. What a miskick by David Hancko (Atl. Madrid). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
21' David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) cushions the ball on his chest then hits a first-time volley high over the bar from inside the box.
20' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Ricardo De Burgos signals. There is a free kick near the sideline to Atl. Madrid.
20' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) offside.
19' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
18' Osasuna take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
17' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. It will be a corner kick for Osasuna.

16' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Sergio Herrera anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
16' The possession of the ball – 70:30.
14' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
13' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Atl. Madrid due to an offside in the build-up play.
11' Wait! Referee Ricardo De Burgos has indicated he is going to review the Atl. Madrid goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

9' It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid). Julian Alvarez plays a fantastic through ball and finds Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
8' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
8' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
7' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) tries to play a long through ball into Victor Munoz, but the defence breaks the move down.
6' Nicolas Gonzalez floats in a cross for Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid), whose header from near the penalty spot is really poor and goes well wide of the right post.

4' What a chance that is! Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the left post!
4' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
2' The free kick from long range, taken by Osasuna, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
2' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Osasuna will take a free kick near the side line.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Osasuna will have the kick-off.
Ricardo De Burgos is the one to supervise the game today.
